description: Dead simple static homepage to expose your server services, with an easy yaml configuration and connectivity check.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-10 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. v26.08.3 is the current release, built 2026-08-30, published for amd64 and arm64. It is a static page server: one container, no database, no credentials and no network access of its own.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Shows a page of links you arrange yourself. It is configured by editing a config.yml file in its own data folder rather than in the app, so it opens with an example dashboard until you do.
